scenarios.prompt: Using repo-kickstart, give me the ordered steps to set up the codebase-memory-mcp structure graph for a fictional TypeScript repository named acme/widget, which has committed node_modules/ and dist/ trees and no graph yet. Do not run any commands and do not create any files, banks or indexes; answer in text only. Include each command or tool call I should run and how I prove each step worked.
scenarios.assert:
L=$(tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < result.txt | tr '
' ' ') && C=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print index($0, ".cbmignore")}') && P=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print match($0, /persistence[" :=]*true/)}') && X=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print index($0, "index_repository(")}') && [ "$C" -gt 0 ] && [ "$P" -gt "$C" ] && { [ "$X" -eq 0 ] || [ "$X" -gt "$C" ]; } && ! printf '%s' "$L" | grep -qE 'persistence[" :=]*false' && printf '%s' "$L" | grep -q 'merge: ours'
scenarios.note: Rule under test: .cbmignore is written before the first indexing, indexing uses persistence=true, and git check-attr merge -- .codebase-memory/graph.db.zst must print merge: ours. The check lowercases the answer and passes when .cbmignore appears, persistence set to true appears after it, no index_repository( call comes before it, persistence is never set to false, and the answer contains 'merge: ours'. It anchors on persistence rather than on the word 'index' because the skill's own preflight names index_repository before the .cbmignore step (docs/LESSONS.md L-007). Known limits: it accepts an index call written without parentheses before .cbmignore, it does not check that the artifact is committed, and it fails a correct answer that writes merge:ours without the space. Both arms start from an empty directory with the installed huhhb@huhhb plugin switched off and no MCP servers (--strict-mcp-config); the skill arm loads a git archive copy of the branch with --plugin-dir, and the baseline arm also runs with no built-in tools (--tools ""), because with tools a baseline read skills/repo-kickstart from a worktree on disk and from the installed plugin cache (docs/MISTAKES.md 4.1, 4.2). Clean baseline before the first bench: 0 of 3. The first bench (at 5d3b5978, a looser check that also accepted persistence=false and check-attr alone): skill 3/3, baseline 1/2; B4 vs baseline and B8 failed and were accepted by decision 16 of the cleanup-pass batch (HUHHB-168). The check was tightened after CodeRabbit round 1 on PR #70, so it was benched again; results below. Dropped before the first bench: ruleset-first-protection (rulesets endpoint before classic protection, no classic PUT). Its three clean baseline runs passed 2 of 3 (docs/LESSONS.md L-003).

scenarios.prompt: How do I install and register the codebase-memory-mcp and Hindsight servers on this machine, once, so that every repository can use them? Do not run any commands and do not change anything; list the steps only.
scenarios.note: Nearest neighbour: installing the two memory servers is machine scope, which repo-kickstart hands to memory-setup and never does itself. The probe passes when repo-kickstart does not fire. The prompt forbids running anything because the probe session has tools.
